description: This file defines configuration structures and enums for push notification setup, including transport modes, distribution modes, and APNs environments, with methods to read configuration from a bundle.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for push notification settings, including transport mode, distribution mode, APNs environment, and relay URL.

methods.name: PushBuildConfig.init
methods.description: Initializes the PushBuildConfig object by reading configuration values from a bundle.

methods.name: PushBuildConfig.readURL
methods.description: Reads and validates a URL string from the bundle, ensuring it is HTTPS and has no user info or query.

methods.name: PushBuildConfig.readEnum
methods.description: Reads an enum value of type T from the bundle, with fallback to a default value.
